description: This file defines a TreeGenerator class used for constructing and diffing hierarchical tree structures, likely for visualization or analysis within a tracing or debugging tool. It includes methods for generating trees with various options, computing differences between tree states, and managing node identifiers and filtering.

classes.name: TreeGenerator
classes.description: A class for generating, comparing, and diffing hierarchical tree structures with customizable options.

methods.name: generateTree
methods.description: Generates a customized hierarchical tree based on input data and options.

methods.name: compareWith
methods.description: Sets a previous tree state for comparison.

methods.name: withUniqueNodeId
methods.description: Configures a callback to assign unique IDs to nodes.

methods.name: withModifiedCheck
methods.description: Sets a custom function to determine if nodes are modified.

methods.name: generateFinalTreeWithDiff
methods.description: Generates a tree highlighting differences from a previous state.
